credits.title: Montpellier
credits.overview: In the year 1721, Sebastià Calaf, a mercenary grayed by war, tracketh a ravenous beast alongside his nephew Jaume, knowing not what foul horror awaiteth their steps.

credits.title: Ministry of Oneiric Affairs
credits.overview: The Ministry of Oneiric Affairs is a metaphysical place located somewhere in the multiverse. The peculiar officials who work there are in charge of writing down the dreams of all living beings since the dawn of the universe and space-time.
